title: The Score Granularity Gap in Black-Box LLM Classification: A Comparative Study of Confidence Constructions
abstract: arXiv:2606.22179v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as black-box classifiers in pipelines that automate confident decisions and route uncertain ones to human review. Such selective prediction needs a confidence score that an operator can threshold at a chosen risk level. Prior work asks whether LLM confidence is well calibrated or well ranked; we ask a complementary, deployment-oriented question that has been largely overlooked: at what resolution can the score be thresholded? We call the answer the score granularity gap. Through a controlled comparison of seven ways to build a confidence score, from a single verbalized number, to token probabilities, to querying the model many times and combining the answers, across 25 model-dataset pairs (9 LLMs, 3 benchmarks), we find that single-shot verbalized confidence, once correctly converted to a class probability, ranks cases surprisingly well, yet takes only a handful of distinct value

translated_title: 黑盒LLM分类中的分数粒度差距：置信度构建方法的比较研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.22179v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被部署为黑盒分类器，用于自动化决策管道，并将不确定案例路由至人工审查。这种选择性预测需要一个置信度分数，操作者可以在选定的风险水平上设定阈值。以往研究关注LLM置信度是否校准良好或排序良好；我们则提出一个互补且面向部署的问题，该问题在很大程度上被忽视：分数可以在什么分辨率下设定阈值？我们将答案称为“分数粒度差距”。通过七种置信度构建方法的受控比较——从单一语言化数字、到令牌概率、再到多次查询模型并组合答案——涵盖25个模型-数据集对（9个LLM，3个基准），我们发现单次语言化置信度，一旦正确转换为类别概率，排序案例出奇地好，但仅取少量不同值。
tldr: 本文揭示了黑盒LLM分类中置信度分数的“粒度差距”，即单次语言化置信度虽排序性能良好，但取值有限，限制了阈值设定精度。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the "score granularity gap" in black-box LLM classification, showing that single-shot verbalized confidence ranks cases well but takes few distinct values, limiting thresholding precision.
